scope.b5a_policy: unaffected; do not modify or rerun; original DEVELOPMENT result remains immutable

provider_semantics.observed_rollover_regime: ordinary provider no-quote interval may surround 17:00 America/New_York; no candle is synthesized for the gap

frozen_boundary_definition.open: the open of the first genuine native paired M1 candle whose start timestamp is at or after T0
frozen_boundary_definition.close: the close of the last genuine native paired M1 candle whose completion time is at or before T1
frozen_boundary_definition.causality: the completed-day close may use only a candle fully completed by T1; no post-T1 observation may influence it
frozen_boundary_definition.execution: first strictly-later executable genuine native paired M1 observation after decision timestamp T1

calendar_membership.candidate_close_dates: Monday through Friday in America/New_York only
calendar_membership.open_membership: T0 <= candle start < T1 and the candle start has the same America/New_York civil date as T0
calendar_membership.close_membership: T0 < candle completion <= T1 and the candle completion has the same America/New_York civil date as T1
calendar_membership.weekend_policy: Saturday and Sunday close dates are never candidates; lookup may not cross a New York civil date to bridge a weekend, full-day holiday closure, missing-data day, or partial dataset edge
calendar_membership.holiday_or_missing_policy: reject the intended weekday FX day unless genuine paired observations satisfy both civil-date membership rules

prohibited: using the first post-boundary quote as the prior day close
using any post-boundary observation in the completed-day statistic
inventing Saturday or Sunday FX days
bridging a full-day holiday or missing-data closure
trying another boundary convention after observing the amended rerun

unchanged_semantics.B5B: AUD/CAD native; exactly 20 completed closes including current; below mean long, above mean short; one position; reverse on sign crossing; native, 1.5x, and 2.0x costs; rollover-supported requirement and all original gates unchanged
unchanged_semantics.B5C: frozen five-pair universe; completed-day open-to-close return; prior 30 completed returns; sample SD; strict plus/minus 2 SD; contrarian next complete FX day; one position per instrument; native, 1.5x, and 2.0x costs; all original gates and breadth unchanged

governance_disclosure.prior_exact_boundary_result: the exact-boundary implementation produced structurally truncated 2019-2021 B5B/B5C daily samples
governance_disclosure.clarification_basis: provider timestamp and rollover semantics only
governance_disclosure.corrected_result_status: DEVELOPMENT evidence only and post-observation methodology clarification
